source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-20

procedures.title: Main cylinder: remove, overhaul and install
steps: Fit the diaphragm in the reservoir cover, put the cover on the cylinder and snap the bail wire over to hold it.
(Installation) Put the push rod through the push rod retainer if it was taken apart.
Push the retainer over the cylinder end, press a new boot over the push rod and down onto the retainer, and slide a new mounting gasket into place.
Bolt the main cylinder to the firewall.
Connect the push rod clevis to the brake pedal with the pin and retainer.
Connect the brake lines to the main cylinder.
Fill the reservoirs to the levels in figure 7 in the manual and bleed the brakes.
Adjust brake pedal free play if needed.
notes: Wheel cylinder and anchor pin service on this page applies to drum brakes only and is not included.
